title: TERRA GRATA drops a new single "God Never Left"
htmlContent:
American-based singer, songwriter and producer TERRA GRATA drops a new single titled "God Never Left," a powerful record that uses its time with the listener to put the world on notice and gives us all something think about. Musically its in a class of it’s own with it all being done to a supreme level, while also pouring into the listener to make something truly timeless.
